summary: Candel Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a new at-the-market (ATM) equity program of up to $50.0 million of common stock sold through Jefferies as sales agent or principal, under a Second Amended and Restated Open Market Sale Agreement dated November 12, 2026. The prior $50.0 million ATM facility was fully exhausted and terminated. Jefferies earns a fixed 3.0% commission; no escrow applies. Shares trade on Nasdaq under CADL, last close $9.22 on November 11, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and overhang.
